name: Blockbuilder
summary:
Blockbuilder is a first-person VR brick workshop. Sit or stand at the table, grab a stud, and start stacking. Controls stay out of the way so the bricks feel like they are in your hands: grip to pick up, trigger to place, rotate and scale when you want a different piece, and open the workshop menu from the left controller.

Build with a real variety of bricks — plates, slopes, tiles, and more — in a full color set. Snap them to the grid or drop them loose. Crank a piece up from tiny studs to oversized block
